title: Check a path number
summary: Phoenix: Check a path number. Visit /double/4cats.
introduction: Integer.parse reads a number and the unused text. Open GET /double/4.
learningObjectives: Check a path number with Phoenix

blocks.text: Create an app named school with mix phx.new school --no-ecto --no-html --no-assets. Enter school and run mix deps.get. Put each labelled section in its named file, then run mix phx.server. Use http://127.0.0.1:4000.

blocks.title: Check a path number
blocks.code:
# lib/school_web/router.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.Router do
 use SchoolWeb, :router
 pipeline :api do
  plug :accepts, ["json"]
 end
 scope "/", SchoolWeb do
  pipe_through :api
get "/double/:n", LessonController, :twice
 end
end

# lib/school_web/controllers/lesson_controller.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.LessonController do
 use SchoolWeb, :controller
def twice(conn, %{"n" => raw}) do
 case Integer.parse(raw) do
  {n, ""} -> json(conn, %{answer: n * 2})
  _ -> conn |> put_status(400) |> json(%{error: "Use a whole number"})
 end
end
end

blocks.text: Integer.parse returns both 4 and an empty remainder. That exact pattern accepts the input.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Check that no trailing text remains after the parsed number.
